messages:
Ashley: quick sync - bringing up rhea-13b int4 (group-quant) on canary, seeing two issues: small but consistent quality drop on long-form prompts and reproducible OOMs on cold starts when users request >600 tokens.
Priya: what's the quant profile and defaults you're using?
Ashley: profile=v2b (group4), batch=12, max_new_tokens=256, gen_window=32. Local eval: ppl +0.7 and random extra hallucinations on multi-step instructions. OOMs show during first few sessions after scale-up.
Liam: paste the runtime snippet? and which instance type?
Ashley: canary on g4dn. log snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T09:14:02Z] kv_alloc: allocate 1.2GB
[2026-03-19T09:14:02Z] kv_frag: slot_cnt=24 -> fragmentation spike
[2026-03-19T09:14:02Z] oom: allocation failed at token 512, trying fallback
[2026-03-19T09:14:02Z] fallback: model_variant=rhea-13b-fp16
```
Mika: metrics align - fragmentation spike on warmstart, kv cache grows then small allocs churn free-lists. group4 quant increases allocation granularity which makes compaction less frequent.
Priya: quality drop could be quant bias concentrated in some heads. Try v2a (groupsize=2) and v3-perchannel. Also run a calibration (bias+scale) over ~1k mixed prompts.
Ashley: quick A/B: short-instruct bucket: v2b=78.6, v3-perchannel=81.2. Long narrative still ~0.3 behind fp16.
Liam: for ops, we can mitigate immediately: set catalog defaults: max_new_tokens=192, default_quant_profile=v3-perchannel for rhea-13b. Runtime: kv_compaction_interval=30s, warmup_slots=3, preserve_attention_scaling=true for int4.
Ashley: preserve_attention_scaling cuts hallucination ~15% on dev checks. Good candidate for canary.
Mika: I'll flip compaction+warmup_slots in infra canary. compaction at 30s will add CPU ticks but should reduce fragmentation spikes during warmstart.
Eva: propose adding a quality gate to canary pipeline: if BLEU/ROUGE delta > 0.03 OR avg_confidence < 0.88 then auto-fallback to fp16 for that route. Thoughts? :thinking:
Liam: +1. Also collect token-level perplexity and avg_confidence per route for alerting. Add policy fallback_on_quality_drop=true, threshold=0.03.
Priya: for quant experiments I'll run per-channel calibration across 1024 prompts and recompute bias corrections. If calibration recovers >50% of gap vs fp16 we accept v3-perchannel default.
Ashley: rollout plan:
1) Canary rhea-13b-int4 with: default_quant_profile=v3-perchannel, max_new_tokens=192, kv_compaction_interval=30s, warmup_slots=3, preserve_attention_scaling=true.
2) Run 2k evals across short/instruct/long narrative buckets + monitor memory/ooms for 6h.
3) Quality gate: short-instruct delta <=1.5% and long-narrative delta <=2% and zero OOMs -> promote.
4) Otherwise auto-fallback to rhea-13b-fp16 for failing routes.
Liam: I'll open the model-catalog PR and schedule canary at 10:15 UTC. Deploy-bot, canary please.
Deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-20T10:15:00Z -> rhea-13b-int4 (canary=blue).
Mika: setting fragmentation alert: >2 OOMs in 10m window triggers rollback. I'll watch graphs.
Priya: calibration run started, posting detailed eval numbers in ~2h.
Ashley: I'll run the 2k eval suite after calibration completes. If we hit regressions or unexpected fallbacks I will pause rollout and ping here. :shipit:
